PCPB Hero.label: Hero
PCPB Hero.description: Large opening banner with heading, buttons and the optional product status check box.

PCPB Page Header.label: Page Header
PCPB Page Header.description: Coloured title band for the top of an inside page, with the breadcrumb trail.

PCPB Slider.label: Slider
PCPB Slider.description: Rotating slides with a picture, heading, text and a button each.

PCPB Text.label: Text
PCPB Text.description: A heading and formatted text: paragraphs, lists, links, pictures and tables.

PCPB Cards.label: Cards
PCPB Cards.description: Cards or tiles with an icon or picture, text and a link. As a grid or a carousel.

PCPB Image and Text.label: Image and Text
PCPB Image and Text.description: A picture beside a heading, text and a button.

PCPB Numbers.label: Numbers
PCPB Numbers.description: A row of key figures (for example: products registered, premises licensed).

PCPB Call to Action.label: Call to Action
PCPB Call to Action.description: A highlighted band with a short message and a button.

PCPB Tabs.label: Tabs
PCPB Tabs.description: Several panels of text; the visitor switches between them with tabs.

PCPB Questions and Answers.label: Questions and Answers
PCPB Questions and Answers.description: A list of questions that open to show the answer.

PCPB Gallery.label: Gallery
PCPB Gallery.description: A grid of photographs that open large when clicked.

PCPB Custom HTML.label: Custom HTML
PCPB Custom HTML.description: For ICT staff: your own HTML. Jinja is allowed.

PCPB Register Search.label: Register Search
PCPB Register Search.description: A search box that checks every public register at once.

PCPB Register Index.label: Register Index
PCPB Register Index.description: Cards for every public register, grouped. New registers appear here by themselves.

PCPB Register Table.label: Register Table
PCPB Register Table.description: One register shown as a searchable table, read live from the ERP.

PCPB Registers Strip.label: Registers Strip
PCPB Registers Strip.description: A moving strip naming every register with its record count.

PCPB News.label: News
PCPB News.description: The latest news, notices and circulars. New posts appear here by themselves.

PCPB Tenders.label: Tenders
PCPB Tenders.description: Tenders from the Tenders list. Closed ones move to the archive by themselves.

PCPB Jobs.label: Jobs
PCPB Jobs.description: Open vacancies, read live from HR (Job Opening). Applying happens on the HR job page.

PCPB Leadership.label: Leadership
PCPB Leadership.description: The Board and management, from the Leadership list, as a grid or a carousel. Only current office holders show.

PCPB Services.label: Services
PCPB Services.description: The Board's online services, read live from the portal. Apply takes the visitor to the portal.

PCPB Downloads.label: Downloads
PCPB Downloads.description: Documents from the Documents list (forms, guidelines, reports), by category.

PCPB Contact and Map.label: Contact and Map
PCPB Contact and Map.description: Address, phone, opening hours, the map and the offices, from Settings > Contact.

PCPB Form.label: Form
PCPB Form.description: A web form (built in Desk > Web Form). What visitors submit lands in the ERP record the form writes to.
